content.short: Blend provides per-user on-chain accounts with screening and controls, plus risk-rated yield.
content.description: Neobanks and fintechs integrate Blend to give each of their users an on-chain account with screening, reporting and spending controls already built in. Risk-rated yield runs on top of those accounts, with allocations spread across instruments such as Treasury bills, Aave and Morpho. The whole thing arrives as one non-custodial SDK, and separate paths exist depending on whether the integrator performs KYC on its users. Blend is in production and states eleven audits with no critical or high findings.
